Women's Hospital "Room Harmony" has been etched in my memory as it  was my home for two and a half months.
I had a complicated pregnancy and was advised completed bed rest and was admitted under Dr. Gayatri Rao's guidance who turned my hope into reality. She is the sweetest soul who would brighten my dark days with her encouraging words and smile.
On April 2nd, I delivered a premature baby boy after the long tiring journey.
I would also like to thank the nurses who had made my stay homely with utmost care and positivity. They were nice to me and somehow became my friends by the time I was leaving.
A big shoutout to sisters - Vidya, Hema, Trishala, Smita, Mayuri, Namrata, Alpa, Yashika, Sunita and I might have missed few other names but I am equally grateful to each.

Not only the nurses even the maushis were accomodating everytime I had to use the loo as I was on complete bed rest.

Also, Dr. Manju sinha would keep visiting and advising me to read books for a positivity.

Another appreciation I would want to give the phlebotomist who would come for my blood tests and would tell me lovingly that I would be a good mom. I forgot her name but I hope you guys will find out who she is.

It was a tumultuous journey for both me and my husband, but the way Dr. Gayatri Rao made my pregnancy possible with her positive smile and golden words is beyond everything.

It was a long stay but it became bearable with each and every person mentioned above. Thank you guys, for helping me out during the most fragile yet memorable time of my life. I will always be indebted to this hospital.

The only drawback if I may mention are the charges of the hospital as it is located at the posh side of bandra khar. But, for middle class people like us the charges were indeed challenging.

Cama and Albless Hospital (also called Pestonji Cama & Albless Hospital) is a long-established government hospital in Mumbai that specialises in healthcare for women and children. It is one of the city’s key public referral centres in these areas and operates under the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC).

Location

The hospital is centrally located and easily accessible by train, bus and taxi from across the city.

History & Capacity
The hospital was founded in 1886, making it one of Mumbai’s oldest public healthcare institutions.

It originally started as Cama Hospital and was later renamed Cama and Albless Hospital.

Current bed capacity is around 500+ beds dedicated to women’s and children’s care.

Healthcare for Women and Children:

Maternity care, high-risk pregnancies and obstetrics

Low-cost or subsidised treatment as a public hospital for eligible patients

In late 2025 it became the first public hospital in the state authorised to provide egg freezing and sperm bank services as part of its ART programme.

The hospital is adding educational programs such as a postgraduate diploma in oncology nursing to support cancer care training.

A Centre of Excellence for Women’s Pelvic Health has opened to treat urogynaecological conditions, with modern diagnostics and clinic rooms.

Teaching & Referral Role
Cama and Albless Hospital also functions as a teaching and research hospital linked with Grant Medical College and is part of a network of public hospitals that train doctors and healthcare professionals.
